name: effort-optimizer
description: Picks a reasoning effort for each prompt from four cheap questions: offers a one-line switch (suggest mode) or switches by itself (auto mode), with a cooldown so the prompt cache is not churned.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: suggest: show a Switch button when a different effort fits the prompt. auto: switch by itself and toast. off: do nothing. Change at runtime with /effort-optimizer.

useModel.title: Ask a small model too
useModel.description: Also send each prompt to a small model (haiku) for the four yes/no answers, and combine them with the built-in rules. This sends your prompt text in one extra cheap request per prompt. Off by default.

cooldownTurns.title: Cooldown (turns)
cooldownTurns.description: After a switch, do not downgrade or move sideways again for this many turns (an upgrade for a riskier prompt is never held back). A mid-chat effort change can invalidate the prompt cache, so keep this above 1.

respectManual.title: Respect a level you set yourself
respectManual.description: In auto mode, never override an effort level you changed yourself since the session began.

manualHoldTurns.title: Manual hold (turns)
manualHoldTurns.description: How many turns a level you set yourself is respected in auto mode. After that the mod may switch again. 0 keeps it until /clear. An upgrade for a high-risk prompt (up to xhigh) is applied even during the hold.
